title: Coverage of Stage Estimates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\\{ -1,1 \\}$, let $0<\\tau\\le 1$, and let $k<n$. For any finite family $A$ of subsets of the coordinate set, consider the stage that estimates the frequencies in $C=\\bigcup_{S\\in A}\\{S,S\\cup\\{k\\}\\}$ using the coordinate prefix $J=\\{0,\\ldots,k\\}$. Every possible output trace of this randomized stage contains, for each $U\\in C$, a record whose coordinate set is $J$ and whose frequency prefix is $U$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
$A$ is a finite family of coordinate subsets
the outcome lies in the support of the stage run with target $f$
